title: Cobblebalance
description: Re-balances for Pokémon stats, moves and abilities
body:
This Datapack aims to rebalance a lot of Pokémon by adding more base stat total, minmaxing their stats, adding new moves, adding new abilities or a combination of all at the same time.
### What are the changes?
You can check all the rebalance works on the changes.txt included on the pack. All changes can be seen ingame when using the Pokédex or any info mod. Some examples are:
- **Ledian**, the worst Pokémon, now has a useful attack stat.
- Buffs for every **starter**, including regional forms.
- **Meganium** now has secondary Fairy type and Fairy level up moves.
- **Gengar** now has his Levitate ability back.
- **Lucario** now has Sturdy ability, making it great again.
- Some Pokémon evolve sooner, like **Haxorus** or **Mandibuzz**.

If you got any ideas on how to improve this pack, feel free to **DM me on Discord** or join my server. ¡@nova64 on Discord!
